name: broken-link-auditor
title: Site Migration QA: Check Old URLs Redirect to Live Pages
description: Site migration QA: check that every old URL redirects to a live page. Paste old URLs, a sitemap or a site address and get the final status, the 301/302 redirect chain, redirect loops and 404s for each URL. In crawl mode it also reports the page and anchor text that link to each broken URL, so you can run it monthly as a broken-link report.
seoTitle: Site Migration Link Checker: 301 Redirects and 404s
seoDescription: Site migration QA: check that every old URL redirects to a live page. See 301 chains, loops and 404s from a URL list, sitemap or crawl.
